name: Broad Hearing
description: Open the spirit to every near heart and take in the full weight of what they feel.

name: Pooled Calm
description: Pool the calm of the willing and pour it over those most shaken.

name: Load Lifting
description: Draw the clinging weight of fear out of the nearest allies and spread it thin.

name: Panic Edge
description: Cut the edge of a gathering panic so that it spares the allies near the user.

name: Company Reading
description: Read every heart in a host and rank them by the strength of their purpose.

name: Common Resolve
description: Share a single steady resolve across a host so that no one wavers alone.

name: Pulse Return
description: Call a fallen ally back from the edge by lending them the host's shared pulse of will.

name: Rout Wave
description: Send a wave of unplaced terror through an enemy host and break its order.

name: Dread Swell
description: Raise a tide of felt courage under allies and let it break on the foe as dread.

name: Cleansing Sorrow
description: Cry out the grief of a host so that it leaves them lighter and whole.

name: Veiled Host
description: Hide a whole host in a veil of calm that no hostile feeling can enter.

name: Chorus Seal
description: The school's last act in which every heart in the host sings one feeling and the foe's will falls by the user's reserve.

name: Vast Resonance
description: Make a whole host feel one overwhelming feeling and bring an army to a halt at the destructive ceiling of its tier.
